<div class="card-body">
'''General Dodonna''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Rebel]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ドドンナ将軍</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">「反乱軍参謀」の効果が、同じ位置カードにいるなら２倍、そうでなければ＋１になる。「行き止まり」の効果をキャンセルできる。ヤヴィン４上で彼と同じ位置にいる反乱軍は各人の戦闘力に＋１。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-10o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">熟練した戦術家で生まれながらのリーダー。レイア姫の届けたデス・スターの構造図面を解析後、デススター攻撃計画を立案した。旧共和国時代にはスター・デストロイヤーの艦長。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' General Dodonna.

'''Card text:''' Rebel Planners is doubled if he is at the same site, otherwise +1. May cancel Wrong Turn. Each Rebel present with him at a Yavin 4 site is power +1.

'''Lore:''' A skilled tactician and a natural leader. After analyzing the Death Star schematics Leia delivered, he planned the attack. A Star Destroyer captain in the Old Republic.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese names 行き止まり for Wrong Turn.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[General Dodonna]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
